summary.text: J. Todd Rutherford is a Democratic state representative from Richland County who has represented South Carolina House District 74 since 1999 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, Rutherford is the House Minority Leader and serves on the Ethics and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: Rutherford earned a B.A. from Howard University in 1992 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 1996.

He worked as a legislative assistant to Congressman Robin Tallon from 1992 to 1993 and as an assistant solicitor and special prosecutor of narcotics and drug cases in the Fifth Solicitor's Office from 1996 to 1998.
His biography also lists The Rutherford Law Firm, LLC, beginning in 1998, and a seat on the national board of the NAACP Special Contributions Fund.
Ballotpedia lists Rutherford under the name James Rutherford, also known as Todd, and reports that he faces Republican Collin Shelton in the November 3 general election.
